metin.SexyKO'da bulunan **Kum Saati Sistemi**,: The **Hourglass System** in SexyKO was made so you can follow in-game events live and never miss one.

metin.Bu simge üzerinden oyun içerisindeki etk: From this icon you can quickly check in-game events and open the detailed event window.
metin.Kum saatinin üzerine geldiğinizde, o and: When you hover over the hourglass, an **info window (Info)** opens with what you can see right now.

metin.Bu sistemin temel amacı, oyuncuların oyu: The main goal of this system is to let players follow in-game events much more easily.
